654a906e6758ffe17974dae829d35423dcd827b3.title: Muse Spark 1.3 removed from picker, 1.2 restored
654a906e6758ffe17974dae829d35423dcd827b3.summary: Muse Spark 1.3 withdrawn due to upstream `404 model_not_found` errors. Muse Spark 1.2 replaces it in the free model picker and CLI. Saved 1.2 preferences migrate to 1.3 on load.

26f374dc2bc2abd17e24eabe0c254e426e49d350.title: Muse Spark 1.3 replaces Muse Spark 1.2 in free model picker
26f374dc2bc2abd17e24eabe0c254e426e49d350.summary: Muse Spark 1.3 is restored and replaces Muse Spark 1.2 in the free model picker on Web, CLI, and Desktop. Saved preferences for Muse Spark 1.2 are automatically migrated to Muse Spark 1.3. Muse Spark 1.2 remains available for existing live sessions and installed builds but is retired from new selections.

b0ec8028c8fa97b1e285eb8739988689b8520e7d.title: Refactor slash command filter, export function
b0ec8028c8fa97b1e285eb8739988689b8520e7d.summary: Refactored `filterSlashCommands` in `cli/src/hooks/use-suggestion-engine.ts` to use a shared `matchByIdOrAlias` helper for prefix and substring matching. Function exported.

217906d84aa2113d8c363debba204695a6e074db.title: Landing screen shows auto top-up URL
217906d84aa2113d8c363debba204695a6e074db.summary: Updated CLI landing screen to display auto top-up URL on rate limit errors.

2e67ad0b60df355424e672d6a635b6d5ab2cdad8.title: Document freebuff-web prod-smoke, harness, Node pin
2e67ad0b60df355424e672d6a635b6d5ab2cdad8.summary: Added docs for `freebuff/web` prod-smoke gate. Clarified shared harness responsibilities. Explained per-service Node version pinning.

a8d0c1a83f4dc3677069dec06aca8a2aa3bdfb20.title: Solar Pro 4 pricing logic updated; promo ends
a8d0c1a83f4dc3677069dec06aca8a2aa3bdfb20.summary: Updated internal pricing comments for Solar Pro 4 to reflect that the 90% discount is a permanent rate, not a temporary promo. Added a scheduled change to revert the model to its regular metered price starting 2026-09-13.

4897491493104492eafbdca91dfd2ccda3c00020.title: Add live smoke test docs; support env file injection in e2e sessions
4897491493104492eafbdca91dfd2ccda3c00020.summary: Documented live production smoke test procedure in `freebuff/e2e/README.md`. Updated `freebuff-session.ts` to support optional environment variables written to a secure temp file, preventing secret leakage into indexed project directories.

3cb1fb6862cca34e8ccbba778c11ca697e2a9e05.title: Add production-runtime smoke test docs for web
3cb1fb6862cca34e8ccbba778c11ca697e2a9e05.summary: Documented new `build-web` smoke test running production code under Node to catch runtime API mismatches (e.g., `Promise.withResolvers`). Includes local execution instructions using `bun run smoke:prod` against a loopback Postgres.

72627b4a8b54f0f2fb08b872d0ad770891b87e24.title: Subscription cost report gains observed hours and forecast window fields
72627b4a8b54f0f2fb08b872d0ad770891b87e24.summary: Updated `SubscriptionCostReport` in `common/src/types/subscription-costs.ts` to include optional `observedHours` for completed covered hours, plus `forecastObservationStart` and `forecastObservationEnd` to separate complete-day forecast basis from recent measurements. Documentation updated to reflect completed-hour reporting instead of UTC-day coverage.

51e6c7bcf02623bda9cd8faa187aad7ffeaad37e.title: Add SubscriptionCostMetrics and SubscriptionCostReport types
51e6c7bcf02623bda9cd8faa187aad7ffeaad37e.summary: New TypeScript interfaces `SubscriptionCostMetrics` and `SubscriptionCostReport` added to `common/src/types/subscription-costs.ts`. These define the shape for tracking provider costs, attribution status, and 30-day forecasts for paid subscribers.

0e7e3934db90c7866404ed431039233bc6f1a628.title: CLI path helper use non-throwing root getter
0e7e3934db90c7866404ed431039233bc6f1a628.summary: Switched `getRelativePath` to `tryGetProjectRoot`. Prevents crashes when project root unset during startup or tests. Internal refactor.

dedd70d5414f7b9b98050623b74a4fa850669e1b.title: read_files now returns images as media
dedd70d5414f7b9b98050623b74a4fa850669e1b.summary: The `read_files` tool detects image paths and returns base64 media parts instead of text bytes. This allows the AI to visually analyze images in the project. Hosts without local binary read support continue to receive image paths as text.

aa93519f568da1f67f76245d2f2c9e8724ad9ebb.title: Sponsored compute acceptance price configurable via env
aa93519f568da1f67f76245d2f2c9e8724ad9ebb.summary: Added `FREEBUFF_SPONSORED_COMPUTE_ACCEPTANCE_PRICE_CENTS` to `SponsoredComputePolicyEnv`. `readSponsoredComputePolicy` now validates this price, defaulting to 200 cents if absent. Malformed prices return null, blocking admission.

a784cf2d81b03b3074f794fb5acdcfcb18ef35fd.title: Add house subscription billing A/B experiment utilities
a784cf2d81b03b3074f794fb5acdcfcb18ef35fd.summary: Added `HOUSE_SUBSCRIPTION_BILLING_EXPERIMENT` constant, `parseHouseSubscriptionBillingExperimentMode`, and `houseSubscriptionBillingArmForUser` to `common/src/util/ad-experiment.ts`. These functions provide deterministic, sticky 50/50 assignment between 'monthly' and 'yearly' billing arms for users.

a7ea9ca1fdbf59aea2aedd91b557f4416f19695b.title: Add Gravity Showcase experiment types and analytics events
a7ea9ca1fdbf59aea2aedd91b557f4416f19695b.summary: New `gravity-showcase-experiment.ts` types define A/B test structure and assignment logic. Added `ADS_SHOWCASE_PRESENTED` analytics event and corresponding telemetry validation in `axiom-only-log.ts` and `log-ingest.ts`.

5f024bab305902dc778d74b92756ae6c96cb42f4.title: Raise default ad credit line to $200
5f024bab305902dc778d74b92756ae6c96cb42f4.summary: Default postpaid credit line doubled to $200. Added $100 collection threshold before delivery stops. Growth step minimum fixed to $100.

ebc17a50dc3d760f6d6eb023df4abc508e1dbd9f.title: Add yearly billing support to subscription types
ebc17a50dc3d760f6d6eb023df4abc508e1dbd9f.summary: Added `yearlyPriceUsd` to subscription tiers and `yearlyPriceUsd` to tier offers. Introduced billing interval constants and type guards. Updated `FreebuffSubscriptionInfo` to include `source`, `billingInterval`, and `renewsAt` fields for better client-side handling of subscription states.

1fe7bfe3bb89a5f39ce493861f57c861565e81ed.title: Session types: concurrency + slotLimit in admission response
1fe7bfe3bb89a5f39ce493861f57c861565e81ed.summary: Added `concurrency` and `slotLimit` fields to `FreebuffSessionAdmissionResponse` capacity refusal type. Imported `FreebuffDesktopConcurrency` type. Optional fields; older servers omit them.

1dd01919a42648d9da8f473c4f84b3b0b55b8605.title: Remove unused validation error formatting util

871e0ef0f989d23273c778f4b30eb541c6d0deed.title: Bump freebuff CLI version to 0.0.173
871e0ef0f989d23273c778f4b30eb541c6d0deed.summary: Updated the version number in the release `package.json` to 0.0.173.

4aa36c7b25c32bdc0605e5abfc8529e306dc4dd7.title: Add iOS ad placements to Freebuff
4aa36c7b25c32bdc0605e5abfc8529e306dc4dd7.summary: Introduced `ios-placements.ts` to define native iOS ad slots for chat and coding flows. Updated `freebuff-placements.ts` to include these iOS placements alongside existing web slots.

af898dcad679dbbd27389aef8a674cee31d58d43.title: Allow BYOK resume for hosted sessions
af898dcad679dbbd27389aef8a674cee31d58d43.summary: SDK now permits switching from hosted inference to BYOK when resuming a session. Previously, any source mismatch blocked the run.

2c8541e90dcc9e7641fe7d4ba7c03e1eea64bfa4.title: Clarify spend label; expose modelSpendUsd type
2c8541e90dcc9e7641fe7d4ba7c03e1eea64bfa4.summary: Updated `FREEBUFF_SPEND_UNIT_LABEL` to "model spend" for clarity. Added optional `modelSpendUsd` field to `FreebuffRecentUsage` type.

175ea48e5f9acebbb528cd76425d4f268f0d947c.title: CLI: Add BYOK support
175ea48e5f9acebbb528cd76425d4f268f0d947c.summary: New `/byok` command allows using custom provider keys via environment variables. Selecting a BYOK connection bypasses Freebuff auth, ads, and session limits.

385a72397d899dcd80b9715f1b86adff24faa644.title: CLI: Wallet consent flow, balance unavailable state, session expiry checks
385a72397d899dcd80b9715f1b86adff24faa644.summary: Added `consent_required` session state and pending wallet consent logic to `use-freebuff-session.ts`. `startFreebuffSession` now accepts `walletSpendLimit`. Model selector shows 'balance temporarily unavailable' when `freebucks` is null, and validates active session expiry before allowing switches. New `freebuff-model-selection.ts` utility added.

0cbff57aed44d5a012b9dbb93912884ba1be0ccc.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash replaces V4 Flash in free model picker
0cbff57aed44d5a012b9dbb93912884ba1be0ccc.summary: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash replaces DeepSeek V4 Flash 07/31 in the free model catalog. CLI selector now displays server-driven upgrade offers for limited-tier users.

6bfe1fe6644c350a1d13259cd4141c316e57e1ac.title: Clarify purchased Desktop session pause messaging
6bfe1fe6644c350a1d13259cd4141c316e57e1ac.summary: Added `purchasesPaused` flag to session admission responses to distinguish server-side purchase pauses from model outages. Updated client-side labels to explicitly state that the model is fine and purchased sessions are temporarily paused, preventing users from incorrectly assuming the selected model is unavailable.

bf468de5940335611a1669118edb2540e6618f6e.title: Extend Desktop idle release to 15m, add session headers
bf468de5940335611a1669118edb2540e6618f6e.summary: Increased `FREEBUFF_DESKTOP_IDLE_RELEASE_MS` from 10 to 15 minutes. Added `x-freebuff-desktop-admitted-at` and `x-freebuff-desktop-attempt-id` constants for stable tab tracking and unacknowledged POST identification.

2570b57ebdbf98f703cd9515379d76615eb48e4a.title: Update house ad copy, add after-hours artwork
2570b57ebdbf98f703cd9515379d76615eb48e4a.summary: Added new `freebuff-pro-after-hours` WebP artwork and markdown documentation for the subscription campaign. Updated `Desktop-Spotlight` and `Desktop-Showcase` ad variations to reuse approved campaign copy, replacing previous session-count specific text.

f48d871ed62bc99da5c8486f58e5847750fcb2fd.title: Thinker agent switched to GPT-5.6 Luna, reasoning effort expanded
f48d871ed62bc99da5c8486f58e5847750fcb2fd.summary: The Chat thinker agent now uses GPT-5.6 Luna with extra-high reasoning instead of DeepSeek V4 Flash. Reasoning effort levels `max` and `xhigh` added to agent definition types.

5f45bd81450eb50ba253ec315e067f798771d98a.title: Set Solar Pro 4 price to 0 Freebucks
5f45bd81450eb50ba253ec315e067f798771d98a.summary: Added price change transition for Solar Pro 4 to 0 Freebucks. Updated comments to reflect historical price preservation.

c8894546fb126b852322d188c60fd21efc9a0faa.title: Clarify update-required message for old Desktop builds
c8894546fb126b852322d188c60fd21efc9a0faa.summary: Server now flags `updateRequired` when old Desktop builds can't resume purchased time. New messages clarify model is fine, update needed, no extra charge.

4cb83e770ab4290df3813b4526fcd55978f5a323.title: CLI shows plain-English errors for sponsored task refusals
4cb83e770ab4290df3813b4526fcd55978f5a323.summary: CLI now translates internal error codes into user-friendly sentences for sponsored task refusals. Added a central registry for Supabase format experiment campaign pairs to prevent configuration drift.

cc9069e251e8fedd5784c688ce78ccfecd76815f.title: Sponsored procedure runtime inputs
cc9069e251e8fedd5784c688ce78ccfecd76815f.summary: Sponsored runs now pass advertiser CTA URL as separate runtime input. Procedure text stays unaltered to preserve consent hash. CLI displays sanitized advertiser link if present.

81f78e0c885af9edb97960bf8e8497cf1a45e6a1.title: Ignore GHA OIDC credentials
81f78e0c885af9edb97960bf8e8497cf1a45e6a1.summary: Added `gha-creds-*.json` to `.gitignore` to prevent accidental commits of short-lived GitHub OIDC credentials.

b816aed976efe357204d4878122710062c89ec89.title: Add purchase continuity claim types and refund metadata
b816aed976efe357204d4878122710062c89ec89.summary: Introduce `purchase_claim_released`, `purchase_in_use`, and `purchase_capacity` session statuses. Add `FREEBUFF_PURCHASE_CONTINUITY_HEADER` for single-use execution claims. Extend API responses with `desktopPurchases` and `desktopRefunds` metadata.

54ba9b4874e7b588f9f771155853fa42e2218765.title: Version bump to 0.0.172
54ba9b4874e7b588f9f771155853fa42e2218765.summary: Updated CLI package version from 0.0.171 to 0.0.172.

e9ebac6cb68071c635ef41d4d6807073a57b513c.title: Forward resolved client IP to Imprezia ad requests
e9ebac6cb68071c635ef41d4d6807073a57b513c.summary: Added `clientIp` parameter to `fetchImpreziaChatAd` and `fetchImpreziaDisplayAd`. Server now forwards single resolved end-user IP via `X-Forwarded-For` header to Imprezia API. Improves ad targeting accuracy and fraud detection.

df46a33ebe7178f9f9a56740f859e846215f982d.title: Switch Solar Pro 4 to non-ZDR endpoint
df46a33ebe7178f9f9a56740f859e846215f982d.summary: Solar Pro 4 now uses `upstage` instead of `upstage/zdr` for debugging. Data use remains 'service' with training traces disabled.

a8def7f03d62efcc46ff246bb83a69443036aa27.title: Remove unused agent message tree helpers
a8def7f03d62efcc46ff246bb83a69443036aa27.summary: Deleted `getDescendantIds`, `getAncestorIds`, and `isAgentVisible` from `cli/src/utils/message-tree-utils.ts`. These internal helper functions are no longer used in the codebase.

358336a18e557894e7bbdd623c43e34f1bc54f6f.title: CLI v1.0.688
358336a18e557894e7bbdd623c43e34f1bc54f6f.summary: Version bump to 1.0.688. No user-facing changes.

17106e2e4b02aee3ffa07db72fad3327df43b1b2.title: CLI shows refund status and updates end-session description
17106e2e4b02aee3ffa07db72fad3327df43b1b2.summary: CLI now displays refund pending and completed status in landing screen. `/end-session` description updated to mention 90% cost refund. Session release logic moved to store with refund polling support.

abd1eed4ab8de4111232935a21962b5a03ff5a33.title: Fix accidental model selection and unresponsive priced-out rows
abd1eed4ab8de4111232935a21962b5a03ff5a33.summary: Resolved a critical bug where dismissing the Freebucks intro card accidentally started a session on the cheapest model. Fixed an issue where model rows that were too expensive for the user's balance did not respond to clicks or Enter, preventing access to pricing info.

6e661ec6984d33a02c3a592348b160d68dacfee3.title: New common/constants/freebuff-earn.ts
6e661ec6984d33a02c3a592348b160d68dacfee3.summary: Added `common/src/constants/freebuff-earn.ts`. Refactored CLI referral banner to import earn constants from new module.

92c4f5ef87df3e074a688d0c635c551b51d46b37.title: Muse Spark 1.3 removed, 1.2 added to free model picker
92c4f5ef87df3e074a688d0c635c551b51d46b37.summary: Muse Spark 1.3 is withdrawn from the free model picker due to persistent `404 model_not_found` errors across all keys. Muse Spark 1.2 replaces it on all surfaces (Web, CLI, Desktop). Muse Spark 1.3 is paused to prevent retry loops for existing clients.

7539eacf2a73bfcbfdb5e37cf88fdcc494361cf5.title: Add error body to Imprezia client logs
7539eacf2a73bfcbfdb5e37cf88fdcc494361cf5.summary: The `postToImprezia` function now captures and logs the response body (truncated to 300 chars) when an API error occurs. This provides visibility into rejected fields and causes for failed ad fetches.

95e3f5f94d99ac80eeac8306d46296208263d5bd.title: Restore premium session limit to 5
95e3f5f94d99ac80eeac8306d46296208263d5bd.summary: Reverted `FREEBUFF_PREMIUM_SESSION_LIMIT` and tier-specific `premiumSessionsPerDay` from 4 back to 5. Removed `FREEBUFF_PRE_LEVELS_PREMIUM_SESSION_LIMIT` and `FREEBUFF_PRE_LEVELS_LIMITED_SESSION_LIMIT` constants as the Levels feature is retired.

04578916f453fcab40ef1d5dac060e94ab126108.title: Peak-pricing badge in model selector
04578916f453fcab40ef1d5dac060e94ab126108.summary: Adds peak-pricing badge to model selector with tooltip showing surcharge and end time in local timezone. New `freebuff-peak-price.ts` util exports `isFreebucksPeakModel` and `freebucksPeakCopy`. `FreebuffFreebucksPeak` type added to session types.

3e63daca691768e95055f250f95cdf1404b251ad.title: Remove daily spend ceilings, add session pacing
3e63daca691768e95055f250f95cdf1404b251ad.summary: Deprecated per-account daily spend limits (`FREEBUFF_DAILY_SPEND_USD`) and `turn_spend_limit` errors. Replaced hard refusals with soft session pacing targets. Fixed 409 response parsing bug in session API.

5454338099733607d45ae7442117bf2879569637.title: Limited tier hero switches to GLM 5.3 Flash
5454338099733607d45ae7442117bf2879569637.summary: Freebuff now recommends GLM 5.3 Flash as the default hero model for limited-access users. DeepSeek V4 Flash remains the internal coercion target to ensure fallback safety if the meter rolls back.

f396f4ef37618acc07c9b6c7e461695e3d357e72.title: Freebuff daily compute cap raised to 4x Freebucks value
f396f4ef37618acc07c9b6c7e461695e3d357e72.summary: Updated `FREEBUFF_FREEBUCKS_CEILING_NOTICE` constant. Daily compute cap increased from 3x to 4x Freebucks value.

8d21e42dbfa0c7509ffc294601a55f9a95a2cd25.title: Update turn spend limit error message
8d21e42dbfa0c7509ffc294601a55f9a95a2cd25.summary: Rewrote `FREEBUFF_TURN_SPEND_LIMIT_MESSAGE` to be concise. Removed internal diagnostic details about agent loops. Clarified that session remains available for new messages.

f1ebb9710b9ba26d96f19a1cf8e6fb2e2ae71c8b.title: Add ads.mcp_tool_call event to Axiom-only logging
f1ebb9710b9ba26d96f19a1cf8e6fb2e2ae71c8b.summary: Introduced `ads.mcp_tool_call` event type with allowlisted fields for advertiser MCP operation census. Content-free logging of tool, outcome, error code, and duration.

ec6003e6dc37caba65b92c4eca3adb7595eca4e3.title: Version bump to 0.0.171
ec6003e6dc37caba65b92c4eca3adb7595eca4e3.summary: Updated release package version from 0.0.170 to 0.0.171.

4972f1e7a75e6c7f2421c55040c0746c9e5d97da.title: Fix false spend ceiling rejections for Freebucks meter
4972f1e7a75e6c7f2421c55040c0746c9e5d97da.summary: ResolveFreebuffSpendCeiling now skips `elevated_country` and `trust_level` limits when `onFreebucksMeter` is true. This prevents valid accounts from being incorrectly blocked by legacy budget cohorts.

54ce330ea151686b4a999b1318617b6c6a069644.title: Show Freebucks daily reset countdown in CLI model selector
54ce330ea151686b4a999b1318617b6c6a069644.summary: Added a countdown timer (e.g., "resets in 4h 12m") to the Freebucks header line in the CLI model selector. This helps users track when their daily Freebucks allowance refills, matching the behavior on Web and Desktop.

872fc2305848cdcdd0e5d4199e211b9f82831fe1.title: Advertiser redaction v2: country codes visible
872fc2305848cdcdd0e5d4199e211b9f82831fe1.summary: Added `country_excluded` and `country_unresolved` to operator, safe, and visible reason codes. Bumped `ADVERTISER_REASON_REDACTION_VERSION` to `v2`. Users now see specific country refusal reasons.

253ee6c497c3d67371a7cddabfeacaebb19e308a.title: Free model spend no longer drains daily allowance
253ee6c497c3d67371a7cddabfeacaebb19e308a.summary: Added logic to exempt spend on models currently offered for free from the user's daily dollar allowance. This prevents using free-tier models from locking users out of paid features due to budget limits.

52fa3fb94d1b2957fdefa82afae8158a0ae19cff.title: Untrack local config files
52fa3fb94d1b2957fdefa82afae8158a0ae19cff.summary: Added `.env.local.example`, `xcuserdata/`, and `.claude/settings.local.json` to `.gitignore`. Ensures local environment and IDE-specific settings are not committed.

02ec3583806e4bf811825a7f7bc3a1082c4583d3.title: Added Freebuff Pro sponsor break hero assets and copy
02ec3583806e4bf811825a7f7bc3a1082c4583d3.summary: Added new SVG and PNG hero assets for Freebuff Pro sponsor breaks. Updated core constants to include specific ad creatives and placement IDs for Desktop Spotlight and Showcase breaks.

78d1eebe0a27ffa9f8d4d3b6d38261f19d5acd11.title: CLI release 1.0.687
78d1eebe0a27ffa9f8d4d3b6d38261f19d5acd11.summary: Published CLI version 1.0.687. No functional changes.

a4b3d0fa55c77663581617e15840fb467c110159.title: Add accent span parser and placement format labels
a4b3d0fa55c77663581617e15840fb467c110159.summary: New `common/src/ads/accent-span.ts` module parses, validates, and strips `*word*` accent markup for sponsor breaks. `freebuff-placements.ts` adds explicit format labels for Desktop/CLI slots and frequency copy. CLI version bumped to 0.0.170.

d3d99f4c5a6e4bc6fbb83c81ea8b7a63cb53e0b4.title: Version bump to 0.0.169
d3d99f4c5a6e4bc6fbb83c81ea8b7a63cb53e0b4.summary: Updated package version in `freebuff/cli/release/package.json` from `0.0.168` to `0.0.169`.

c4093bf714387f3c5bda94d19d5181c0543054e1.title: CLI: clearer usage-limit copy, day-scale reset, carry Freebucks block
c4093bf714387f3c5bda94d19d5181c0543054e1.summary: Landing screen now says "Daily usage cap reached" for metered accounts, formats long waits as days, and reworded reset/upgrade lines. Refusal responses carry the held Freebucks block so the meter renders correctly. Hard-ceiling notice rewritten.

fb0ab0941b7c17b23b57e0d950f836d852c4d912.title: CLI Freebucks meter: monthly usage, referral copy
fb0ab0941b7c17b23b57e0d950f836d852c4d912.summary: Landing screen shows monthly usage limit and reset time when metered. Referral banner simplified to Freebucks copy for metered accounts. Header line labels Freebucks and monthly usage.

76a5696e5fdd93b9dc8dded8d2d0c8fac82937ab.title: Default model switched to GLM 5.3 Flash
76a5696e5fdd93b9dc8dded8d2d0c8fac82937ab.summary: GLM 5.3 Flash is now the default model for all users, replacing DeepSeek V4 Flash. The model picker order and documentation have been updated to reflect this change.

e6c61f451394b49df437af776c496a0365474fd6.title: Solar Pro 4 free Labor Day weekend promo
e6c61f451394b49df437af776c496a0365474fd6.summary: Solar Pro 4 costs 0 Freebucks Sep 5–7 (PT). CLI model selector updates prices live as server schedule transitions occur.

2cd4966460ec52724504da1424e2aaa7f56b6e95.title: Add sponsor break event validator and interrupting placement predicates
2cd4966460ec52724504da1424e2aaa7f56b6e95.summary: Adds `isSponsorBreakEvent` to validate untrusted event names against the closed set. Introduces `isInterruptingBreakFormat` and `isInterruptingBreakPlacement` to distinguish screen-interrupting formats (spotlight, intermission) from non-interrupting ones (showcase) for correct daily cap application. Updates `dismiss_lock_ms` documentation to clarify shared usage across formats.

b9d72aecc22730807ca4c2d450c9f9b1c0c6739b.title: Add sponsor break dismiss lock metrics
b9d72aecc22730807ca4c2d450c9f9b1c0c6739b.summary: New event fields `dismiss_lock_ms` and `lock_completed` added to sponsor break payloads. Internal utility `clampSponsorBreakDismissLockMs` added to bound lock duration (0-5s).

4ac0d8ab8584d5ada8c2f0bda35ab6b7c974e02f.title: GLM 5.3 Flash gains limited access; Freebucks metering in CLI
4ac0d8ab8584d5ada8c2f0bda35ab6b7c974e02f.summary: README updates show GLM 5.3 Flash now available for limited access users. CLI session summaries and model selectors integrate `getFreebuffModelMeter` to display Freebucks balances and model-specific quotas alongside legacy session limits.

7d386183ac1fba92b91d0fd6116ed7f61dbacd6d.title: Clarify freebucks bonus expiry and nextBonusAt semantics
7d386183ac1fba92b91d0fd6116ed7f61dbacd6d.summary: Updated `FreebuffFreebucksWallet` type docs. `nextBonusAt` now explicitly denotes current period end, remaining present during scheduled cancellation. Bonus retirement logic clarified: occurs on new credit or upgrade, not solely at subscription end.

e8a3c7930b8024d099e2c2abf75ff582798a73c9.title: Fix limited-region model catalog leak. Gemini 3.8 Flash now Pro-only.
